body.objective: Make Science Forge lease acquisition and lifecycle transitions atomic against one another so a resident pull cannot resurrect a terminal, retired, blocked or coordinator-dispositioned item from a stale fold, and so one resident agent cannot acquire two live exclusive work leases on different items through a cross-item pull/assign race.
body.stop_condition: Land a compare-and-swap transaction for `s-f work pull`, `work assign`, coordinator transitions and lease release.  A pull must capture the folded item's maximum authoritative event sequence/digest, acquire a programme/item lock or equivalent atomic guard, refold immediately before authoring ACTIVE plus LEASE-ACQUIRE, and refuse if the state, sequence, dependency satisfaction, queue position or live lease changed.  In the same transaction, index live exclusive leases by agent identity across the programme and refuse pull or assign when that agent already owns a different live exclusive lease; return the conflicting item and its expiry.  ACTIVE and LEASE-ACQUIRE must commit as one logical transaction or leave neither event.  A terminal/BLOCKED/RETIRED transition racing a pull must either linearize before the pull and make it fail, or linearize after a fully committed pull with an explicit live-lease disposition; it must never create a later ACTIVE resurrection from a pre-transition fold.  A yielded lease after a terminal or missing-dependency SHORTFALL report must not append READY unless an explicit coordinator/dependency-satisfied transition authorizes reopening.  Add deterministic two-process barriers reproducing the live physics failures: (1) black-hole-asymptotic-jordan-metric-reconstruction was RETIRED at seq 4 and later yielded READY at seq 8; (2) observer-temporal-curl-second-jet-or-all-jet-disposition received coordinator OBSTRUCTED at seq 3 at 19:38:36 but a resident stale pull authored ACTIVE seq 4 at 19:38:43; (3) bridge-1 was coordinator-assigned bridge-global-bounded-cone-real-zero-locus and thirteen seconds later independently pulled bridge-local-anomaly-zero-charge-sector-chain-maps, leaving two live exclusive leases for one agent until the coordinator yielded the earlier lease.  Prove exactly one legal linearization, byte-idempotent retry, no orphan lease event, no duplicate work package, no agent with two live exclusive leases, and correct overview/work-show diagnostics.  Expose a coordinator-safe `work terminalize` or equivalent that can atomically apply terminal state plus lease disposition after a reported result without impersonating the worker.
body.forbid: no best-effort sleep or polling window; no reliance on wall-clock ordering instead of append-only sequence/predecessor/CAS state; no deletion or rewrite of historical race events; no global repository lock held during scientific computation; no silent worker lease revocation without a typed event; no terminal state inferred from prose; no READY resurrection merely because a lease was released; no weakening one-exclusive-lease discipline
notes: The earlier SHORTFALL-readiness fix correctly handles close-out events carrying a typed missing dependency.  This request is the orthogonal transaction race: a resident can begin from an older fold while a coordinator terminal event is being appended.
The observer regression is current and minimal: report at seq 1, SHORTFALL/release seq 2, coordinator OBSTRUCTED seq 3, then stale resident ACQUIRE/ACTIVE seq 4 seven seconds later.

The black-hole wrapper independently demonstrated terminal retirement followed by a later READY resurrection.  Both have precise event files in planning/events and should become imported acceptance fixtures.
This should compose with SF5 isolated git transactions and the resident-await feature; lifecycle CAS must not depend on the shared Git index.
